writeup.key_factor: The goaltending gap is confirmed and it is the whole play: Ilya Sorokin (5-2-0, 1.72 GAA, .934 SV%) is the Islanders' projected starter across multiple sources, while Los Angeles counters with Darcy Kuemper (1-3-1, 3.94 GAA, .869 SV%) or backup Anton Forsberg (.883) — both well below league average. New York is 5-3-1 and 4-1 at home allowing just 2.11 goals per game with an 87.5% penalty kill; the Kings are 1-4-2 allowing 3.86 goals per game with a 64% penalty kill. Mathew Barzal has been out since training camp, so the Islanders' current form is already priced without him. The price improved from -113 this morning to -101 at BetOnline.ag against our fair line of -152.
writeup.risk: The raw +10.1 edge is likely inflated: the NHL rating is still last season's final Elo and six separate edges of +6.7 or more appeared tonight, the classic stale-rating signature — the corroborated goaltending and form gap is what carries this play, not the raw number. Los Angeles has dominated the recent head-to-head series (9-1 in the last 10). Pass if the price drops below -129, where the edge falls under the 4% NHL gate.
